ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; macro-level ratio of approximately 85% high-intensity white to 15% low-intensity black/dark pixels on visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white central region. Dark black pigmentation mapping forms a continuous trailing edge border and tip caps. A dark vertical projection is mapped from the peduncle base to the median notch. Small discrete black circular blobs are detected on the mid-left lobe and upper-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 75-80 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 15% of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 5-12 pixels along the continuous trailing boundary; most pronounced peaks occur on the medial portion of the trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges curving toward the distal tips; trailing edges exhibit a broad concave curve directed toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of five discrete dark circular clusters on the white field: three small clusters on the mid-left lobe and two larger clusters on the upper-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, unaligned dark linear pixel streaks (~40-60 pixels in length) detected on the right lobe surface, oriented diagonally towards the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Textured, high-intensity gray/white clusters (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; several irregular missing pixel segments (notches) along the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly textured, calcified protrusions at the distal tips distinct from the smooth pixel topography of the fluke membrane.
